completion:
Grab the building plans.
3. In the building plans, locate the entry doors, exit doors, and accessible door openings.
4. Determine which inspection records are for which doors.
5. For all of the inspection records that do NOT show the doors as passing inspection
6. Find the corresponding door in the building plans
